name: @kanzo-tech/mosaic
description: The Mosaic conversation, without React — coordinator, clients and clauses re-exported as one surface, plus the Arrow column reader and the id-set client that every consumer of them was writing by hand.
//peers: mosaic-core and mosaic-sql are REQUIRED, not optional, and that is the whole point of this package: there is nothing here without them, so a host installs them once and both @kanzo-tech/ui/analytics and @kanzo-tech/graph/duckdb see the same coordinator. Two copies would be two crossfilters. @uwdata/vgplot is deliberately absent — it is a plotting library, it belongs to the charts in @kanzo-tech/ui, and its accidental presence on this path is exactly the bug this package exists to end. @duckdb/duckdb-wasm is absent for the same reason it is absent from @kanzo-tech/graph: nothing here names it, and a host that boots its own DuckDB depends on it directly. The two ranges differ — mosaic-core ^0.29.2, mosaic-sql ^0.29.0 — and that is not drift: mosaic-sql published exactly one release in the 0.29 line, so ^0.29.2 does not resolve. Each range names the newest patch that exists.
